system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 1 Intermediate. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Intermediate (1): Way of Passage

Base rating-tracker for the Thaumaturgy (Way of Passage) Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
